summary: German merchant turned amateur archaeologist Heinrich Schliemann tore through the mound at Hisarlik in Ottoman Turkey in the 1870s, destroying much of the Troy he sought and smuggling out treasure; the story opens with Giuseppe Ferlini wrecking a pyramid at Meroe.
